selection.course_codes: random.Random(20261007).sample of 12 codes per yearbook from module-description chunks (title + 'This/The module/course ...'), excluding Stage 4 codes and codes whose description titles differ; first 5 per book -> exact code, next 5 -> code in context, 2 spares per book
selection.natural_language_topics: random.Random(20261007).sample of 22 from 152 numbered section headings on pages <= 200 (general regulations), excluding Stage 4 topics; taken in sample order, skipping (a) department/faculty names and learning-outcome bullets, (b) more than 2 postgraduate-research topics, (c) headings with no substantive section text (rule (c) added while drafting: 'Structure of Semester' only refers to Faculty Regulations; 'Transfer of Technology' exists only in a table of contents)
selection.answer_pages_found_by: plain text search of the chunk text for each section's distinctive wording - no retriever used

grading: 2 = chunk alone is sufficient for an LLM to answer correctly; 1 = relevant but insufficient; 0 = irrelevant

questions.question: What is a faculty board responsible for?
questions.sufficient: Lists faculty board functions: regulate teaching and study of the faculty's subjects (subject to Senate approval), report to Senate on faculty matters, deal with matters referred/delegated by Senate

questions.question: How are archaeology students taught and assessed?
questions.sufficient: Teaching: lectures, tutorials, labs, seminars, group work, site visits, field school, excavations, research projects; assessment: written and oral exams, tests, field school reports, seminar presentations, final-year project reports

questions.question: Who chairs Council meetings when the Chancellor is not there?
questions.sufficient: The chairman of Council presides, or in his absence the vice-chairman; if all are absent, members present elect someone to preside

questions.question: Who are the members of Midlands State University?
questions.sufficient: The membership list: Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Pro-Vice-Chancellors, Council members, Senate members, staff (+ registered students and Convocation, which continue on p.15). Grade 2 for the chunk with the main list (a)-(f); the p.15 continuation alone is grade 1

questions.question: Can I switch from an MPhil to a PhD, and when?
questions.sufficient: Yes: after at least 12 months of study, on supervisor recommendation, with a Faculty Higher Degrees Committee recommendation to Research and Innovation; DCAA recommends to Senate

questions.question: If something in my residence room gets broken, will I have to pay for it?
questions.sufficient: Residents must compensate the University in full for damage they cause; damage to a study-bedroom is presumed caused by its allocated resident unless proved otherwise

questions.question: What qualification do I need to apply for an MPhil?

questions.question: What do I have to sign when I register as a student?

questions.question: How does the university decide to award an honorary doctorate?

questions.question: If I repeat a module, which marks will count?
